notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Most clothing and footwear are exempt; formal wear, sporting goods and fur are taxed (small share, treated as exempt).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Pennsylvania local sales tax exists only in Allegheny County (1%, countywide, Pittsburgh included) and Philadelphia (2%); every place takes its county rate, so "places" is empty.
Clothing and groceries are exempt in Pennsylvania (see the taxability file); this file gives the general rate.
